test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "have lost."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The grammatical reason to use **"have lost"** in the blank is to maintain subject-verb agreement in the past perfect tense.
 
• **"Have lost"** is the present perfect tense form of the verb **"lose,"** and it agrees with the subject **"most people," **which is plural.
 
• The phrase **"who have lost"** indicates that the action of losing a loved one has occurred in the past and has relevance to the present moment.
 
• This usage effectively communicates the idea that most people who have experienced this loss continue to find the subject unfamiliar.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

Correct paragraph:

Alkaline hydrolysis is rare today as a funeral practice__ for humans. Offered to the public for the first time just over a __decade__ ago, it is now permitted and regulated in 26 U.S. states, and practiced __primarily__ in North America, where it remains unfamiliar to most people who __**have lost**__ a loved one or who are thinking about what could ______ (5) ______ to their own bodies when they die.
